description: This file is a Kivy application demonstrating custom on-screen keyboards, including UI layout, keyboard mode management, and event handling.

classes.name: ModeScreen
classes.description: Screen allowing user to select and set keyboard mode, with warning about system-wide effects.

classes.name: KeyboardScreen
classes.description: Screen providing available keyboard layouts and handling keyboard input events.

classes.name: KeyboardDemo
classes.description: Main application class managing the screen flow.

methods.name: on_pre_enter
methods.description: Prepares the ModeScreen by detecting current keyboard mode and updating display.

methods.name: set_mode
methods.description: Sets the keyboard mode in configuration and prompts restart.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Transitions to the keyboard layout screen.

methods.name: _add_keyboards
methods.description: Adds buttons for each available keyboard layout.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main application, setting up screens.
